split_strategy: Records are grouped by scenario_id. Every style (S1/S2), grammatical person, and prompt suffix of one scenario shares one split. Within each polarity, scenario groups are shuffled with the dataset seed. The first round(n * test_fraction) groups in each polarity form the test split, leaving at least one train group per polarity. Grouped K-fold cross-validation runs only on the train split, assigning whole scenarios to folds by round-robin after a seeded shuffle within polarity. The layer is selected by mean held-out AUC. The test split is scored once after selection and is not used to fit the direction or to choose the layer.
note: Generated textual categories are hypotheses and may contain linguistic confounds.
